_provenance: Real capture: POST https://ai.syln.cn/a2a against a live production agent (昆仑/Kunlun, found via a2aregistry.org), 2026-07-07. Its Task object's 'status' field is a plain string ('completed'), not an object with a 'state' field ({'state': 'completed'}) like every other agent tested. Before _normalize() normalized this, calling status.get('state', ...) on a raw string crashed with "'str' object has no attribute 'get'" -- a real Python exception leaking out of our own parsing code, not a clean protocol-level error. Also uses role:'assistant' (a third role-naming convention, OpenAI-style) and {'type':'text',...} parts -- both already handled fine, since neither is checked by name/value anywhere in the parsing path.
